record.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 MDPO trains masked diffusion language models to close the training/inference gap. The method is focused on diffusion-language-model training and sampling; the reviewed paper does not establish a general autoregressive LLM serving or KV-cache optimization, so the lineage link is weak.
record.title: MDPO: Overcoming the Training-Inference Divide of Masked Diffusion Language Models
